title: Sidney Bechet and his brother Leonard; Big Eye Louis
summary: Playing with Bechet before he left New Orleans, his sitting in, and Dr. Leonard Bechet.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Sidney Bechet: the man, the horn, the legend

blocks.x: Sidney Bichet was with Noble Sisson.
Did you ever play with Sidney? Yeah, sure. Sidney come up right around me. He did. We played together several times. Sidney Bichet. He's nice too.

No, he's in Paris. He likes it in France. Yeah. He's been there. Did he have a wife? Did you take him? Yeah, he's had two wives since he was in Europe. I'm German. I'm rather old. Let me see. Somebody has seen Sidney recently. He came back from France and said he's married a real young girl now. Sidney Bichet.
He is a good clarinet player.

Yeah, I knew his brother very well too. A doctor. That's right. He died three years ago. Yeah. I always went to see him every time I go to New Orleans on vacation. He's having me there for dinner. Yeah. Offly nice. Yeah, Leonard was a nice guy. He played trombone. Yeah, he so did. He died, you say? Yes, he wasn't too good a musician. He was a doodest, wasn't he? He was a dentist. Yeah. He fixed up a cape for Sidney and he fixed up Bunk's ball, Steve. Bunk playing with ball, Steve. Yeah.
Had Dr. Bichet in there. Dr. Bichet. He's nice. He's a nice fellow. Leonard, I think his name was.
Yes, Leonard. When did you play for Sidney?

I played with Sidney before he left. He left here. I played a couple of jobs. Not here. He left New Orleans. And I played a couple of jobs with him. And he used to come. But that's where he got his start, right with us. We used to take him and let him play, you know.

and he had that style too, that Big Eye Louie style, that clarinet, and he'd come with us, we'd let him, he'd call that sitting in, let him sit in, you know. I was glad to sit in because he was catching on, you know, a lot of stuff, and he'd come over and play with us sometime, we'd let him sit in, and he had that system like Louie, Big Eye Louie, but he wasn't reading so much, you know.
They tell me Louie didn't read so much either.
Not in the beginning until he went on the boat, they said.
Then he really had to learn to read on the boat.
